propositions: [operator-attested] evidence contracts demand provenance of the attestation event but not the measurement, allowing wrong-environment and wrong-privilege evidence to pass unchallenged

Provenance declaration must capture environment, principal, privilege_posture (production-equivalent/broader/narrower), and instrument (live-call/simulation/static-analysis) as required continuation-line fields under the checkbox item, with non-placeholder justification

A deterministic check validates presence and non-placeholder shape of all four provenance fields and enum membership, making no judgement about correctness—only an AGENT-tier LLM criterion judges semantic contradictions against repo anchors
The criterion ships advisory and never blocks, so pre-contract [operator-attested] items are grandfathered and continue claiming without migration breakage

Evidence produced under broader privilege than production, or via simulation/static-analysis on authorization claims when production-equivalent privilege demands live-call, cannot exhibit the failure the criterion rules out
